source:
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> Idle: Bot started
    Idle --> Scanning: Session open + daily loss cap OK
    Scanning --> Idle: No valid setup
    Scanning --> InTrade: Signal confirmed, order filled
    InTrade --> Closing: TP / SL / time-stop hit
    Closing --> Cooldown: Position flat, P&L booked
    Cooldown --> Scanning: Cooldown timer elapsed
    Cooldown --> Idle: Session closed
    Scanning --> Halted: Daily loss cap breached
    InTrade --> Halted: Broker / feed disconnect
    Halted --> Idle: Manual reset next session
    Idle --> [*]: Bot stopped
    classDef live fill:#16a34a26,stroke:#22c55e,stroke-width:2px
    classDef risk fill:#dc262626,stroke:#ef4444,stroke-width:2.5px
    classDef wait fill:#2563eb22,stroke:#3b82f6,stroke-width:2px
    class Scanning,InTrade,Closing live
    class Halted risk
    class Idle,Cooldown wait
caption: Lifecycle of an automated trading bot. The green path is where it makes money; the real engineering is the red Halted state — a robust bot must reach it cleanly on a loss-cap breach or feed disconnect, never keep firing orders blind.
